note: Private mountain campground on Hemptown Creek near Morganton/Blue Ridge; the creek is stocked with trout about every two weeks (license and trout stamp needed). Pool open Memorial Day to Labor Day. --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms $45 (30 A full hookup) / $50 (50 A), pop-up E/W $40; electric set 50; 32 RV sites on its map (21 sewer). Showers, flush toilets, laundry, wifi, store. Phone booking with deposit; 3-night summer-holiday and 2-night October-festival minimums; check-in/out 1 pm. Gate: $45 < $50 passes (no gateway within 40 km; not a Good Sam Park). Presence: own website + phone 706-374-6494, Google Maps 4.3 / 206 reviews. Pin matches the office (Google point ~45 m away). max_rig_ft 40 and pull_through (derived) left alone: the site says only 'RVs of all sizes' and the map shows no pull-throughs either way. Season year_round (derived) left: the site is silent. Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: WATERFRONT lead (stored 'not waterfront'): the operator's map draws Hemptown Creek directly behind RV sites 1-24 (sites 1-4 and 22-24 electric/water, 5-21 sewer), with the pads backing onto the bank; its home page says 'Nestled by Hemptown Creek' and the tent sites are 'along Hemptown Creek'. Imagery: the site row runs along the tree line south of the office/pool and the creek is under canopy there, so imagery neither confirms nor vetoes. A stream that size would be 'creekside' if the gate is met.
Pop-up rate: the $40 row is labelled 'Pop-Up without sewer'; the fee base is the $45 full-hookup site, the cheapest a motorhome is clearly offered.
